ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-5,
Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-3, Community Shopping District; C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District; and C1-3, Neighborhood Commercial District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 11-G in the area bound by:

      West Montrose Avenue; North Sheridan Road; a line 100.15 feet north of and parallel to
      West Montrose Avenue; a line 87 feet northwest of the intersection of West Montrose
      Avenue and North Broadway Avenue as measured along the east right-of-way line of
      North Broadway Avenue and perpendicular thereto; a line 25.2 feet east of and parallel
      to North Broadway Avenue; a line 121.6 feet northwest of the intersection of West
      Montrose Avenue and North Broadway Avenue as measured along the east right-of-way
      line of North Broadway Avenue and perpendicular thereto; a line 30.2 feet east of and
      parallel to North Broadway Avenue; a line 132.6 feet northwest of the intersection of
      West Montrose Avenue and North Broadway Avenue as measured along the east right-
      of-way line of North Broadway Avenue and perpendicular thereto; a line 35.2 feet east of
      and parallel to North Broadway Avenue; a line 186.6 feet northwest of the intersection of
      West Montrose Avenue and North Broadway Avenue as measured along the east right-
      of-way line of North Broadway Avenue and perpendicular thereto; a line 200.15 feet
      north of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue; North Sheridan Avenue; the alley next
      north of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue; a line 150 feet east of and parallel to
      North Hazel Street; West Montrose Avenue; North Sheridan Road; a line 204.95 feet
      south of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to
      North Kenmore Avenue; a line 43.35 fee south of and parallel to West Montrose Avenue;
      and North Kenmore Avenue;

to those of a B3-5, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ___________________________
                                                          Angela Clay
                                                          Alderperson, 46th Ward

4420-4430 N. Sheridan Road
